notes:
A350 and 777:
• New: Flight full screen. A screen left alone for two minutes in flight shows the map, flight data, close-up, journey, below you and route in turn, without the menu. Neighbouring screens show different pages. A tap brings the menu back.
• New: A full-screen button in the corner of the Flight pages. Flight now cycles all six pages, not just two.
• New: Tapping any poster in Movies features that film at the top.
• Improved: Screens out of sight no longer update in the background, which saves performance in large cabins.
• Improved: Small text is larger, and the Order and Next question buttons are easier to hit.
• Improved: The night page and quiz colours follow the airline. Long airline names end with an ellipsis.
• Fixed: Automatic announcements no longer stay on the screens for the whole flight when the take-off wasn't recorded.
• Fixed: A new flight plan loaded in the air keeps the time in flight and the track flown.
• Fixed: The destination forecast no longer disappears while it refreshes.
App:
• Fixed: Automatic updates install what's on the aircraft, not changes you haven't applied yet.
• Fixed: The Cabin app stays closed after you quit it from the tray.
• Improved: A clear message when the A350's cabin files still hold parts of an older install.
